verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for a consumer AI assistant app, but the evidence documents only UI-driven features: code import via menus, Gems, scheduled actions, notebooks, Connected Apps, Live and image editing. None of them is documented as reachable through an API. The runtime probe found that gemini.google.com exposes no agent-docs or MCP discovery surface and that the Gemini developer API on ai.google.dev is a separate product, so community mentions of API pricing do not show parity with this app's features.
